Extended version of the basic HTML selec: Extended version of the basic HTML select.
infinite-scroll-desc: With infiniteScroll, the scroll event is emitted when the user gets close to the bottom (or top) of the list. Use it to load more results — typically the next page from a backend. infiniteScrollDistance and infiniteScrollThrottle tune the trigger threshold.
selection-override-desc: selectionOverride replaces the selection display. As a string, %size% is replaced by the number of selected items; as a function, you freely build the displayed text from the current selection.
selection-nowrap-desc: selectionNoWrap forces the selection onto a single line (no wrapping) in multiple mode. Combined with selectionOverride, it enables a compact selection display.
basic-desc: Basic usage of ng-select2: pass the options through [data] and bind the selected item with [value].
multiple-desc: Add the multiple attribute to let the user pick several options at once.
checkbox-desc: With showOptionCheckbox, each option is displayed with a checkbox in front of its label.
grid-desc: Use grid to lay the options out in a grid instead of a single column, with a configurable number of items per line.
tags-desc: Show one or more labels (tags) per option using the templates to render extra information next to each item.
resettable-desc: The resettable attribute adds a clear (×) button to reset the current selection.
auto-create-desc: With autoCreate, the user can create new options on the fly by typing a value that is not in the list.
position-desc: Control where the dropdown opens with listPosition (above, below or auto).
template-desc: Customize how options and the selection are rendered with the templates and templateSelection template references.
highlight-desc: Enable highlightText to highlight the searched term inside the matching options.
select-all-desc: In multiple mode, showSelectAll adds a button to select (or unselect) every option at once.
native-keyboard-desc: The nativeKeyboard attribute reproduces the keyboard behaviour of a native HTML select, where the arrow keys change the value without opening the dropdown.
multiple-drag-desc: With multipleDrag, selected items can be reordered by drag and drop in multiple mode.
ng-options-desc: Declare options directly in the template with <ng-option> and <ng-group> instead of the [data] input.
limits-desc: Fine-tune the search and selection with minCountForSearch, maxResults and limitSelection.
events-desc: React to the component events: update, open, close, focus, blur, search and autoCreateItem.
form-control-desc: Integrate ng-select2 with Angular Reactive Forms through FormControl and FormGroup.
others-desc: Miscellaneous cases such as dynamically changing the [data] and switching the interface language (i18n).
style-desc: Change the look of the component with styleMode (material, borderless, noStyle) and custom classes.
wai-desc: Accessibility example using ARIA attributes such as ariaLabelledby to make the component usable with assistive technologies.

typeahead-intro: With the typeahead attribute, the selection area becomes a text input. The bound value is the raw text typed by the user, or the label of a picked suggestion. The dropdown filters suggestions while typing and the Enter key validates the typed text.
typeahead-basic-desc: Filtering is done automatically on the client side, on the labels of the provided list.
typeahead-server-desc: With customSearchEnabled, filtering is delegated to your code through the search event. This is the most representative use case: query a backend as the user types and feed the results back through event.filteredData(). Here minCharForSearch waits for 2 characters before searching.
typeahead-reset-desc: Combine typeahead with resettable to show a × button that clears the field, resets the suggestions and closes the dropdown.
